provenance.independent_p_model: props-hb.ts Gamma-Poisson per-player shrinkage; one player-prop at a time, no cross-player/script/total covariance
provenance.note: Descriptive correlations only; priced:false; not a CLV claim.

team_target_share_sum_stats.note: Share sums to ~1.0 => shares are compositional (constrained simplex).

A_compositional.interpretation: Raw targets of co-active teammates are POSITIVELY correlated (shared team-game volume), but their SHARES are NEGATIVELY correlated (compositional constraint: sum to 1). The independent-p model sees neither — it treats each player's count as an independent NB.

B_game_script.interpretation: Team pass volume (dropbacks) is strongly driven by the game script — total_line (over/under) and spread. A higher total and being a smaller favorite → more dropbacks → more targets/receptions for EVERY receiver on both teams. The independent-p model only conditions on per-player rest/weather covariates, NOT on the shared script draw (plays/PROE/pace), so it cannot co-move a game's receiver props with the script.

C_team_total_envelope.interpretation: A sizable fraction of each receiver's game-to-game target-count variance is explained by the TEAM's dropback volume (the shared envelope that the independent-p model replaces with a season-average rate). The residual share-variance (which the Dirichlet share core in masterplan §3.2 models) is compositional across teammates.

D_cross_market_samegame.interpretation: Same-game, same-team props are correlated through the shared game state (QB volume → all receivers; compositional share → teammates). Each is an edge opportunity the independent-p model's per-prop probOver cannot see. A single 'e = p - q' is computed for each market in isolation.

correlations_missed_by_independent_p.multi_player_teammate: target shares sum to 1 (Dirichlet-compositional); teammates negatively correlated on share, positively on same-game raw counts. props-hb.ts computes each player's NB posterior independently — no teammate covariance.
correlations_missed_by_independent_p.game_script: team pass attempts correlate with total_line r=0.177, with spread r=-0.011. Script (plays/PROE/pace) is a shared driver of all pass-catcher volumes; not in props-hb.ts.
correlations_missed_by_independent_p.team_total: team dropback volume explains 13.1% (mean) / 9.6% (median) of receiver target-count variance — the season-average rate props-hb.ts conditions on ignores this per-game envelope.
